thread_text:
1. Who needs $50M most?

Smaller businesses are getting hit by AI-driven attacks and have no security defenses. Inforcer just raised $50M to fix that gap.

Inforcer gives you the same level of protection big companies use, but without the enterprise cost. No budget upgrade needed.

4. Test before you're locked out.

Competitors are already moving into this space. The window to get ahead with Inforcer is closing.

5. Try Inforcer today.

Go to their site and request a demo this week. If you run a small business, can you afford to wait until after a breach?
